scope: Exact implementation contract recovered from code, configs, and persisted diagnostics for reported ACEB experiments.
important_caveat: This file records the implemented experiment contract, not an idealized or proposed ACEB contract. Values not present in code/configs/diagnostics are marked NOT_RECOVERED.

implemented_rule.description: For each pair of views j,k, compute the set of shared item ids. If n_shared >= min_shared_items, include the edge. The empirical centered cross-view moment is recorded and flagged as positive if moment > min_positive_moment, but edge inclusion does not require positivity.
implemented_rule.centering_rule: Subtract each view's mean estimate before computing cross-view moment.
implemented_rule.zero_or_negative_moments: Retained as edges if n_shared passes threshold; edge_is_positive records the sign test.

main_graph_synthetic.notes: Config synthetic_graph_main_paper.yaml does not override min_shared_items.

intervention_synthetic.notes: Paired intervention graph diagnostics were built with min_shared_items=1 in the intervention code paths.

component_oracle_ablation.notes: Component variants attach graph diagnostics with min_shared_items=1.

same_coverage_ablation.notes: This script uses the simulated graph design and does not write a separate co-observation graph diagnostic.

negative_control.notes: Dense complete observations are simulated; no co-observation graph threshold is used.

medhelm_full_fast.notes: Method diagnostics may also contain baseline-attached graph summaries from _with_graph_diagnostics with min_shared_items=1; the reported run-level graph_diagnostics.json uses the runner value.

summeval_appendix_pilot.notes: SummEval has method-diagnostic graph summaries only; no separate graph-regime diagnostic output was produced.

candidate_anchor_set.value: Exactly one view marked is_reference_view in view_metadata.

admissible_anchor_conditions.value: No degree, overlap, rank, or conditioning admissibility threshold is implemented for ACEB fitting. The only validation is exactly one boolean reference view.

if_no_admissible_anchor.value: Data validation raises an error if zero or multiple reference views are marked.

summeval.value: view metadata generated by runner; exact view selected is the first reference view in prepared metadata.
summeval.uncertainty: The exact generated view_metadata lines are not separately cited here because the runner code builds the table inline outside the inspected excerpt.

multi_anchor_fitting_in_main_results.source: No main HELM/synthetic runner invokes multi-anchor aggregation; anchor sensitivity sweep refits each anchor separately in scripts/run_anchor_sensitivity_ablation.py:296-308.

anchor_stable_decision_intersection.value: not used in reported main result tables/figures
anchor_stable_decision_intersection.source: No implementation path found in inspected runners; mark as NOT_USED rather than a hidden default.

synthetic_false_best_threshold.uncertainty: The exact false-best threshold implementation line was not separately traced in this audit; metric naming and configs record 0.95.

stage_1_prior_fit.objective: negative Gaussian marginal log likelihood plus l2_prior * (sum(w_mu^2) + sum(w_v^2))

stage_2_loading_fit.objective: negative Gaussian marginal log likelihood plus l2_view_scale * sum((a_j - 1)^2) over non-reference views; reference scale fixed to 1

stage_3_residual_noise.objective: method-of-moments residual calibration, not optimized by likelihood

bias_b_j.actual_diagnostics: Reported ACEB diagnostics sampled in main/intervention/SummEval contain fit_view_bias=false and center_reference=false.

prior_mean.value: feature-based linear prior mean X @ w_mu; if no item features are provided an intercept is inserted

penalty_differs_by_experiment.source: No config override of l2_prior/l2_view_scale found for reported configs; ModelConfig defaults used.

a_j_positive.value: non-reference loadings optimized as exp(log_scale); reference loading fixed at 1

tau_j_nonnegative.value: tau2 is positive-part truncated, clipped to [extra_noise_lower^2, extra_noise_upper^2], then square-rooted

synthetic.value: not used; truth theta is exact

logit_clipping.notes: Bounded-binomial misspecification mentions logit construction in config, but the exact clipping line was not inspected for this contract.

gradient.value: finite-difference numerical gradient by scipy because jac is not supplied

stopping_tolerance.source: Only options={'maxiter': max_iter} is passed in src/cmveb/models/anchored_eb.py:66,98.

number_of_restarts.source: No restart loop in fit_prior_hyperparameters or fit_non_reference_view_scales.

convergence_failure_rule.aceb_staged: Optimizer result.success is not checked in staged ACEB; diagnostics store objective history and tau diagnostics.
convergence_failure_rule.runner_failures: Runners catch exceptions and write failed outputs unless strict=True.

leave_view_formula.value: For each row, subtract that row's sufficient-statistic contribution from the item posterior; tau2_raw_j is mean((y_ij - b_j - a_j m_{i,-row})^2 - a_j^2 V_{i,-row} - s_ij^2) over rows in view j; tau2_j=max(tau2_raw_j,0) clipped to bounds.

in_sample_formula.value: mean((y_ij - b_j - a_j m_i)^2 + a_j^2 V_i - s_ij^2) with positive-part/clipping by view.

unit_crossfit.value: Implemented but not used in main reported runs; refits nuisance parameters on item folds, then uses leave-view posterior on held-out items.

tau_scope.global_variant: aceb_global_tau pools leave-view tau2 across views in component/oracle ablation only.

inverse_variance_all_views.definition: Per item, posterior mean is inverse-variance weighted average of all observed estimates; variance is reciprocal total precision.

random_effects_meta_analysis.definition: Per item DerSimonian-Laird-style random-effect variance max(0,(Q-(n-1))/c), then weights 1/(se^2 + random_effect_variance_i).

adaptive_shrinkage_like.definition: Collapse all views to inverse-variance estimate/variance; fit zero-centered normal mixture with grid [0, geomspace(max_abs/20,max_abs*2,12)] by EM.

posthoc_inverse_variance_all_views.definition: Fits inverse variance, then inflates posterior variance by scalar c^2. If truth is supplied, c^2=max(1,mean(z^2)) on a random calibration subset using target truth; otherwise c^2 is estimated from held-out views.

target_label_use.synthetic_main_graph_and_intervention: truth is passed by graph_synthetic.run_graph_methods; target-calibrated/oracle-like for synthetic comparisons.
target_label_use.medhelm_full_fast: truth_eval is passed by helm_runner.run_methods; target-calibrated/transductive.
target_label_use.summeval_appendix: truth=None is passed; view-heldout calibration only, no expert targets supplied.

joint_eb_full.definition: Joint L-BFGS-B marginal likelihood fit over feature prior parameters, non-reference log loadings, and log extra noise; reference loading fixed to 1; extra noise clipped above at 10.

helm_orientation.lower_is_better_transform: estimate and target_estimate multiplied by -1; raw values preserved.

helm_leakage_guard.value: Raises if target_estimate is missing unless allow_view_mean_truth=True.

not_recovered.quantity: Exact command line for every reported run
not_recovered.reason: Some run scripts and configs are present, but a complete command log for every artifact was not found in inspected paths.
The code does not set them; only maxiter is explicitly passed.

not_recovered.quantity: A formal admissible-anchor function h beyond exactly-one-reference-view validation
not_recovered.reason: No such function or threshold was found in the actual fit path.
